acceptance: The cli-routing help names which subverbs write policy.json
No registry summary claims read-only for a verb with a writing subverb (test)
fix: Correct the summary and the per-verb help so each writing subverb is marked, following docs/conventions/cli-design.md (effects named in help). Add a help test that pins it.
summary: The registry summary of `cli-routing` says read-only, but `init`, `set`, `unset` and `migrate` write .evolve/policy.json. An operator or agent who trusts the help can change routing without knowing it. Found by the CLI review of 2026-11-24.
title: cli-routing says it is read-only, but four of its subverbs write policy.json
